## Restaurants

### Marchesi 1824 (Milan)
Meal Type: Breakfast
City: Milan
Country: Italy
Address: Via Santa Maria alla Porta 11/a, 20123 Milano
GPS: 45.4642, 9.1897
Hours: 07:30 - 20:00
Notes: Historic 200-year-old pastry shop famed for artisan chocolates and morning espresso.
Must-Order:
- Pistachio Croissant (€4.5) Best served warm from the oven
- Italian Hot Chocolate (€6.0)

### Trattoria ZaZa (Florence)
Meal Type: Lunch
City: Florence
Country: Italy
Address: Piazza del Mercato Centrale 26r, 50123 Firenze
GPS: 43.7766, 11.2533
Hours: 12:00 - 23:00
Notes: Legendary bustling trattoria beside San Lorenzo market; arrive 30 mins before peak lunch hours.
Must-Order:
- Bistecca alla Fiorentina (€45/kg) Signature T-bone steak, recommend rare or medium-rare
- Tagliatelle al Tartufo (€16) Fresh wide pasta in black truffle butter sauce
- Tiramisù (€8.0)

### Caffè Gilli (Florence)
Meal Type: Cafe & Snack
City: Florence
Country: Italy
Address: Via Roma 1r, 50123 Firenze
GPS: 43.7733, 11.2542
Hours: 08:00 - 22:00
Notes: Florence's oldest café founded in 1732, featuring open-air seating under Piazza della Repubblica arcades.
Must-Order:
- Thick Hot Chocolate (€7.0) Rich and velvety like pudding
- Pistachio Cake (€6.5)

### Roscioli (Rome)
Meal Type: Dinner
City: Rome
Country: Italy
Address: Via dei Giubbonari 21, 00186 Roma
GPS: 41.8944, 12.4732
Hours: 12:30 - 23:30
Notes: Renowned Roman gourmet deli-restaurant; its Carbonara is widely considered the best in the city.
Must-Order:
- Spaghetti alla Carbonara (€16) Must-try signature dish
- Supplì (€5.0)
- Roman Ricotta Cake (€7.0)
